canonical_description: Matte white freestanding two-door top-freezer refrigerator in an ordinary home kitchen, viewed initially from a rear three-quarter angle.
invariant_features: same kitchen environment when the physical object is visible
forbidden_variations: change to French-door or side-by-side layout
replace with a different refrigerator model
move to an unrelated kitchen without a context switch
alter component locations merely for visual convenience
continuity_constraints: All physical refrigerator scenes must derive from A1 or an approved derivative.
Technical abstractions should preserve the recognizable fridge_01 silhouette when shown together with the appliance.
Scene 5 may compare heat-rejection layouts but must keep fridge_01 as the primary example.

style.lighting: Soft natural indoor daylight with believable room shadows; no studio glow.
style.camera_style: Grounded real-camera perspective, mostly rear three-quarter and controlled cutaway views.
style.environment: Ordinary compact home kitchen; realistic wall clearance and everyday surfaces.
style.color_notes: Neutral household colors; refrigerator remains matte white.

technical_constraints: Do not expose invented internal components in the anchor image.
Keep the rear three-quarter view suitable for later cutaway overlays.
